مقدمة

This document outlines the equipment inspection list I1, which must be performed 
on a monthly bases as indicated by M1 in the title 
block
Technical specifications:

Maximum lifting distance: 
20.7 m بواسطة 
hydraulic telescopic servomotor.

Dimension: 10 4.6 Weight 
: 35 ton

The first draft was initiated by eng. Ashraf Saber , tested by eng. Kamal 
Hassan, accepted by general director eng. Abd elghaffar Osman and approved by 
eng. Ahmed Mohamed Yonis ; Head Sector of Aswan ( 1 & 2 ) Power Station
and certified by eng. Mohamed Osama Soliman HPGC 
inspection and quality control general director.
احتياطات السلامة

The maintenance staff should carry 
 the suitable ID safety category,

The maintenance staff should be well 
 trained, qualified or directly supervised by some one who is.

Safety fence with
caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Wear safety 
and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, gloves, safety glasses ... etc.
Turn off electric power to crane before maintenance proceeding.

Pressure grease gun and feeler 
 gauge, hoses
Mobilplex 47 grease, Mobilux Ep4 grease and Esso surrett Nx 5k gears

sections.text: العمل المراد تنفيذه

Examine and cleaning of servomotor and grease it with Mobilplex 47 
 grease

Check the servomotor seals 
 every three months for excessive leakage
قم بتشحيم عجلة الأسطوانة المتسلسلة كل ستة أشهر باستخدام شحم Mobilux Ep4
Examine the paint work and renew if necessary
Clean the filter cloth and excessively dirty filters should be renewed .

تحقق من الصمامات وموضع البوابة 
 المؤشر كل شهر

Check all terminals and screws 
 for tight seat in control cubical
